title: Open Photonic GPU (OPGPU) / multilambda-voxel-sim: strategies, schematics, instructions and simulations (v0.8.0-research)
description: Open, reproducible conceptual designs, schematics, instructions, models, and simulations for a photonic voxel memory/compute architecture (OPGPU). Includes strategies/families A–G and candidate combinations H1–H5 (prioritized H3, G2, G3, H1, H4), PCIe/OpenCL/OpenVINO compatibility paths, manufacturability/thermal analyses, and feasibility simulations (S1–S4). Intended for universal use and as defensive publication/prior art to hinder appropriative registration of what is disclosed. Conceptual/simulation work only: not validated experimentally and not fabrication/certification-ready. License/rights: repository currently contains mixed licensing (Apache-2.0 code, CERN-OHL-S v2 hardware, CC BY-SA 4.0 documentation) with declared intent by the project to dedicate original works to the public domain (CC0 1.0) as defensive publication/prior art, pending rights-holder consent and execution (see PUBLIC_DOMAIN_DEDICATION.md). Third-party materials, if any, are excluded from dedication.
notes: Reflects current license state of this snapshot; update to CC0-1.0 only after rights holders execute public-domain dedication of all included original works. Exclude/verify third-party data before archival. Conceptual work, no warranty, no FTO/patent guarantee.
